content.value: During the rush hours cars arrive at a city centre car parks at the rate of 35 per (15) 60 minutes. (i) What is the probability of exactly 5 arrivals over a 10 minutes time period. (ii) What is the probability of exactly one arrival over a 10 minutes time period.
